"""DexToolBench claw_hammer/swing_side limited-mode controller record.

No reset, no object state, and no simulator imports. Uses calibrated RGB-D and
joint targets only. The run flag applies the final adaptive grasp attempt from
the episode's current configuration; the service has already recorded earlier
actions in this trajectory.
"""
import argparse
import sys
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
from rcb_client import Robot

CLOSE = np.array([
    .95,.22,.95,.10,.82, .75,0,1.35,.9, .75,0,1.35,.9,
    .75,0,1.35,.9, .12,.75,0,1.35,.9
], dtype=float)

def deproject(rgb, depth, intrinsic_cv, cam2world_gl):
    """Return aligned world-frame XYZ points (metres) from one RGB-D frame."""
    d = np.asarray(depth, dtype=float)
    if d.ndim == 3:
        d = d[-1]
    h, w = d.shape
    fx, fy = intrinsic_cv[0][0], intrinsic_cv[1][1]
    cx, cy = intrinsic_cv[0][2], intrinsic_cv[1][2]
    v, u = np.mgrid[:h, :w]
    p = np.stack(((u-cx)*d/fx, -(v-cy)*d/fy, -d, np.ones_like(d)), -1)
    return p @ np.asarray(cam2world_gl).T

def snapshot(robot, cameras=("top", "side")):
    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=list(cameras), include_depth=True)
    return obs, np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"]), obs.meta["task"]

def submit_targets(robot, target, seconds, cameras=()):
    return robot.submit("joint_position", np.asarray(target, dtype=float)[None, :],
                        dt=seconds, cameras=list(cameras), video="none")

def continue_attempt(robot):
    obs, q, task = snapshot(robot, ())
    base = q[58:87].copy()
    # Move the open hand toward the camera-estimated handle, then close.
    approach = base.copy()
    approach[1] += .03       # shoulder descent
    approach[2] += .30       # elbow moves fingertips toward the shaft in x
    approach[3] -= .10       # wrist moves down and toward the shaft in y
    approach[7:] = 0.0
    close = approach.copy(); close[7:] = CLOSE
    lift = close.copy(); lift[1] -= .10; lift[3] += .18
    robot.submit("joint_position", np.stack((approach, close, lift)),
                 dt=1.5, cameras=(), video="none")
    return snapshot(robot, ("top", "side"))

def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--continue-attempt", action="store_true",
                    help="apply the recorded final approach/close/lift sequence")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    robot = Robot(); spec = robot.spec()
    obs, q, task = snapshot(robot, ("top", "side"))
    print({"control_dt": spec["control_dt"], "task": task,
           "arm_q": q[:7].tolist()})
    if args.continue_attempt:
        obs, q, task = continue_attempt(robot)
        print({"task": task, "arm_q": q[:7].tolist()})

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
